items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: When I went to North Texas State University one of my teacher’s name was Jay Saunders, a great trumpet player there. He’s the one that got me on Kenton’s band. And we’re still really good friends.

ctx.x: Did you learn from listening to guys like him how to play lead?

Oh well any trumpet player worth his salt would say Snooky Young is the father of lead trumpet playing. There’s no question about it. I mean I learned that a long time before I met Snooky Young. When I went to North Texas State University one of my teacher’s name was Jay Saunders, a great trumpet player there. He’s the one that got me on Kenton’s band. And we’re still really good friends. My son’s named after Jay. But he sat me down and he said, “this is Snooky Young and that is the way you play lead trumpet. And…
How about playing the time? Was that different?
